root.name: Rubinstein Opening: Semi-Slav Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Bd3 Bd6 5. O-O O-O 6. b3 Nbd7 7. Bb2

overview: White plays a Colle-Zukertort set-up with e3, Bd3, b3 and Bb2 while Black builds ...e6, ...Bd6, ...O-O, ...Nbd7 and ...c6, a Semi-Slav shape. Both sides castle and develop, then White prepares e4 with Nbd2 and Re1, and Black responds with ...e5. The game is solid and positional.

white_ideas.idea: Prepare e4 with Nbd2 and Re1
Use the long diagonal with Bb2

black_ideas.idea: Play ...e5 or ...b6 to challenge the centre

typical_structures.structure: Semi-Slav pawns on c6/d5/e6 against d4/e3/b3

approach.notes: The set-up works against many Black defences.

level.notes: Plans are simple with little to memorise.

structure.reason: The centre stays flexible until e4 or ...e5.

approach.reason: The Colle-Zukertort set-up can be used against many replies.

plans.reason: Bb2 on the long diagonal and the e4 break.
